t: Lore:Lyg - UESP Wiki - The Unofficial Elder Scrolls Pages
s: According to the teachings of Mankar Camoran, Lyg was ruled by the dreugh in the Dawn Era. The tyrannical dreugh-kings enslaved the "nineteen and nine and nine" oceans of Lyg and fought constant border wars among themselves. This correlates with the teachings of the Tribunal Temple, which state that Molag Bal had served as the chief of the dreughs in a form that was "spiny and armored and made for the sea", the after-image of which was reborn in Tamriel and known as the Ruddy Man.
